title: migrations/GBL-100_exp501_secrets.sql never creates the secrets table in this environment
summary: Discovered during RELEASE-VALIDATOR Step 6 of the ISS-0074 fix run. migrations/GBL-100_exp501_secrets.sql wraps its CREATE TABLE secrets in a DO block guarded by `IF to_regclass('instance_projections') IS NULL THEN RETURN`. Direct psql inspection of both r-co-db-1 (bpm_dev) and r-co-db_test-1 (bpm_test) shows no `secrets` table exists in any schema (public or tenant_default), even though `instance_projections` and `webhook_subscriptions` both exist under the `tenant_default` schema. zig build migrate reports the migration file as already applied (skip). The guard's to_regclass() call appears to resolve against a search_path that does not include tenant_default at migration-apply time, so the guard condition is met (returns NULL, treated as instance_projections missing) and the migration body silently no-ops without ever creating the table it is meant to create.

root_cause.details: Confirmed via src/db/migrations.zig (lines ~197-207): GBL-prefixed migrations run ONLY against the public schema — they are explicitly skipped for every tenant schema. migrations/GBL-073_tnt01_drop_legacy_public_business_tables.sql permanently dropped instance_projections (and webhook_subscriptions, event_type_registry, etc.) from public as part of the TNT-01 schema-per-tenant migration; those tables now exist only under per-tenant schemas (tenant_default, tenant_<uuid>, ...). Because GBL-100 only ever executes against public, to_regclass('instance_projections') always returns NULL there — not due to an ambient search_path edge case, but because the guard checks a table that is structurally guaranteed to be absent from the only schema this migration runs against. The guard therefore always short-circuited and CREATE TABLE secrets never executed, in any environment.

files_to_change: migrations/GBL-100_exp501_secrets.sql or a new corrective migration
resolution: Removed the incorrect to_regclass('instance_projections') guard from migrations/GBL-100_exp501_secrets.sql (secrets is a global public-schema table with no such prerequisite). Re-scoped the webhook_subscriptions backfill in the same file to guard on webhook_subscriptions itself rather than the unrelated instance_projections. Added migrations/GBL-101_exp501_secrets_corrective.sql as a corrective migration (unconditional, idempotent CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS) since schema_migrations already records GBL-100 as applied and editing it in place would not cause a re-run. Added tests/integration/iss0076_secrets_table_test.zig (2 tests, wired into zig build test-integration and a standalone zig build test-integration-iss0076 step) verifying the table exists and Store.putSecret/resolveSecret round-trip against the real table. Verified secrets table now exists in both bpm_dev and bpm_test (63-tenant-schema representative database) via direct psql/pg_tables query; verified absence pre-fix via git stash baseline comparison.

occurrences.context: Discovered incidentally while verifying ISS-0074's acceptance criterion about pre-existing plaintext secrets rows during RELEASE-VALIDATOR Step 6 -- found the secrets table does not exist at all in dev or test DBs.

prevention: docs/anti-patterns.md already documents this pattern (guarding a migration DO block with to_regclass() against a table that only exists in a different schema than the migration actually runs in) — see the entry cross-referenced from GBL-100's file header comment.

Any future GBL-prefixed migration that needs a prerequisite guard must check a table that can actually exist in the public schema, not a per-tenant business table — GBL migrations never run against tenant schemas.
